mil3.3.14:0.3: 14. The Question on the Mark of Examination
mil3.3.14:1.1: “Sir Nagasena, what is the mark of examination”?
mil3.3.14:1.2: “Threshing out is the mark of examination, Great King”.
mil3.3.14:2.2: “Just as, Great King, a plate of bell-metal, beaten in, then resounds as it is pressed into shape; just as, Great King, is the beating in, so the reflection must be seen
mil3.3.14:2.3: As the sounding is, so the examination must be seen”.
mil3.3.14:4.1: The Question on the Mark of Examination, fourteenth.
mil3.3.14:6.1: There are fourteen questions in this chapter.
